title: Higher direct images preserve coefficient-size filtered colimits
statement: Let $h:Y\to X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring, and let $q\in\mathbf Z$. Let $J$ be a filtered small category. The functor $F\mapsto H^q(Rh_*(F[0]))=R^q h_*F$ on small-etale sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves, def-weil-pbc-direct-image] preserves colimits of shape $J$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]: applying this functor to any colimit cocone gives a colimit cocone. Schemes live in universe $u$; the ring, coefficient modules, and objects and morphisms of $J$ live in universe $u+1$. No torsion hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tags 0739 (lemma-colim-works-over-collection), 03Q8, and the fixed-scheme case of 09Z1 (lemma-relative-colimit)

proof.text: For affine etale W over X, its pullback Z to Y is qcqs. Restriction to Z preserves colimits as a left adjoint. Apply etaleCohomology_isColimit_large_filtered to underlying abelian sheaves on Z. The natural comparison nonempty_etaleModuleCohomology_forgetIso transfers this to module cohomology: coefficient forgetting preserves colimits and reflects isomorphisms, hence reflects colimits. The free-sheaf derived-sections comparison identifies the result with maps from the degree-zero free sheaf on Z into a shifted degree-zero sheaf.

Given a diagram D, write G for higher direct image. Sheafify the presheaf colimit of D composed with G and use its colimit universal property to obtain the canonical map a to G(colim D). The source-library raw cohomology presheaf comparison with G is natural and locally bijective. All comparison maps are the canonical maps induced by the coprojections.

For local surjectivity of a, lift a section of G(colim D) locally to a raw cohomology class, then cover by affine etale objects. Step 1 represents that class at a stage of D. Map the stagewise class to its higher image and then to the sheafified colimit. Its image under a is the required restricted section by naturality.

For local injectivity, subtract sections with the same image. Represent their difference locally at a stage and lift this representative to a raw cohomology class. Local injectivity of the raw comparison makes its image vanish locally in the input-colimit cohomology. Refine by affine objects. Step 1 and exactness of filtered abelian-group colimits make the class zero at a later stage. Its stagewise higher image is zero, so the original section vanishes locally. The local-bijection criterion makes a an isomorphism, proving colimit preservation.

For negative q, derived direct image of a degree-zero sheaf is nonnegative by the standard t-structure; its degree-q homology is zero. Thus the zero functor preserves colimits. The positive-degree argument uses only finite covers and finitely many equality witnesses; J remains in Type(u+1). Zero coefficients, empty schemes, degree zero and singleton diagrams are included.
